Whalefall Plot : Following the death of his father (Josh Brolin), Jay Gardiner (Austin Abrams) goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

Whalefall is scheduled to be released theatrically in the United States on October 16, 2026, by 20th Century Studios.

All The Videos In The Channel Are Enhanced To 4K (3840 × 2160 px; also known as Ultra HD and UHD) Quality.
